author: CriticMindSet
quote: 10/10 — Pure Perfection Honestly, I didn't think you could improve on a classic like Ocarina of Time, but Nintendo actually pulled it off. Playing this on the Switch 2 feels like stepping right back into how you remembered the game looking as a kid, just running at a silky-smooth 60fps with gorgeous updated **** best part is how good it feels to actually play now. Being able to swap items without constantly pausing and having proper camera controls completely fixes the clunky parts of the original—even the Water Temple is genuinely fun this time around. Combine that with the re-orchestrated soundtrack hitting all the right emotional notes, and I couldn't put it ****’s rare that a remake lives up to the hype, let alone surpasses it. Easy 10/10, an absolute must-play.

author: CriticMindSet
quote: Grand Theft Auto VI: All Gloss, No GritScore: After a decade of hype, GTA VI looks incredible on the surface, but underneath, Rockstar has completely stripped away the rebellious DNA that made the franchise legendary.Instead of the fearless, unapologetic satire of San Andreas or GTA V, the game is bogged down by safe, sanitized writing and heavy-handed woke agenda messaging. The sharp, irreverent humor is gone, replaced by preachy storytelling that feels terrified of offending anyone.Worse, the dual-protagonist setup completely ruins the classic GTA power fantasy. Rather than rising up as an unstoppable criminal mastermind, playing through the Lucia and Jason dynamic constantly sidelines you, turning what should be a ruthless crime saga into a tedious domestic cuck simulator where you spend more time managing relationship drama and playing second fiddle than actually running the criminal **** VI has the graphics of a masterpiece, but the soul of a corporate lecture. It’s a pretty sandbox that completely forgot what Grand Theft Auto is supposed to be.

quote:
There is so much good i can say about this game in every aspect that would take me more than 5k characters. Its a 10/10 period, and my personal GOTY so far, after 47 hours i can say i am addicted hard to this game, i didnt played the early access, any Baldur's Gate or D&D game before this, i like RPGs in general but never tried these games, the closest i played similar in some ways was all the Dragon's Age saga.
If you like turn based RPG this is a must in your life, if you are broke and cant afford it right now at full price, just go the Jack Sparrow way and when the price is on offer or you can afford it, please buy it if you liked and enjoyed it, this devs pour love and pasion into this game, and you can see it from the first hour playing it. Its amazing the work and effort put behind this game and in top of that NO MICROTRANSACTIONS (at the date of this review, i hope this age well).
This is not a game, this is a life experience.
